Some gas in a sealed plastic bag is placed in a refrigerator to cool down.
How do the gas molecules behave when this happens?
A
They move more quickly and are closer together.
B
They move more quickly and are further apart.
C
They move more slowly and are closer together.
D
They move more slowly and are further apart.

options.label: A
options.text: They move more quickly and are closer together.

options.label: B
options.text: They move more quickly and are further apart.

options.label: C
options.text: They move more slowly and are closer together.

options.label: D
options.text: They move more slowly and are further apart.
